newsitem.title: CHINA: China Textile to offer bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: China Textile to offer bonus issue.

text.p: Shrareholders of China Textile Machinery Co have approved a plan to conduct a one-for-10 bonus issue based on the firm's capital reserves, a company statement said on Tuesday.
The plan was earlier proposed by the firm's board of directors and approved by shareholders at a meeting on Monday, the statement said.
The ex-rights date will be June 9, the statement said.
The company earlier posted net profit of 3.941 million yuan for 1996, reversing a loss of 73.438 million yuan in 1995, based on international accounting standards.
